gmail.purpose: A mailbox: search, read, draft and send messages inside that one Gmail account.
gmail.not_for: Finding someone's email address on the web.

exa.purpose: Web search and page contents: find people, companies, email addresses, facts and pages on the public web.
exa.not_for: Reading or sending mail; anything inside a connected account.

tavily.purpose: Web search with extracted answers: research questions, news, company and people lookups on the public web.

firecrawl.purpose: Scrape and crawl web pages: turn a known URL or site into clean text or structured data.
firecrawl.not_for: Open-ended search when no site is known.

open-router.purpose: Call a large language model: summarise, draft, classify or transform text.
open-router.not_for: Looking up live facts; acting on an account.

google-drive.purpose: Files and folders in Google Drive: find, read, upload, move, share documents.

google-docs.purpose: Google Docs documents: read and edit document text.

google-calendar.purpose: Calendar events and availability: read schedules, create or change meetings.
google-calendar.side_effects: create, update, delete events, send invites

google-places.purpose: Places and businesses on Google Maps: addresses, phone numbers, hours, reviews.

notion.purpose: Notion pages and databases: search, read, create and update workspace content.

slack.purpose: Slack channels and messages: read conversations, post messages, look up members.

stripe.purpose: Payments: customers, charges, invoices, subscriptions, refunds, payouts.
stripe.side_effects: charge, refund, create or change billing objects

meta.purpose: Meta (Facebook / Instagram) business assets: pages, posts, ads and insights.

typesafe.purpose: Typed judgments by TypeSafe Jev: classify, score or yes/no-check text, with calibrated confidence.

github.purpose: GitHub repositories: issues, pull requests, code.
github.not_for: Business work in One or Studio.
